stem: Based on the information in the table, how much more money will a sound engineering technician earn over a period of 5 years than a journalist will?
visual_elements: Table titled 'Media and Communications Annual Salaries' with columns 'Occupation' and 'Salary (dollars)': Journalist - 62,400; Film and video editor - 87,300; Technical writer - 76,860; Sound engineering technician - 67,090.
